item.title: Los Angeles Angels settle lawsuit with family of pitcher Tyler Skaggs over fatal overdose
item.description: SANTA ANA, Calif. (AP) — The Los Angeles Angels reached a confidential settlement Friday with the family of late pitcher Tyler Skaggs after a lengthy trial that detailed drug use by players.

item.title: Christmas spirit alive as residents donate meals and gift cards
item.description: “It’s tough out there and if we can do something for our neighbours in Angus and Base Borden, we will,' says donation organizer Wayne Hay

item.title: Man found guilty of murder in shooting that killed woman near Toronto consumption site
item.description: TORONTO — A man accused in a Toronto shooting that killed a bystander and cast a spotlight on supervised consumption sites was found guilty of second-degree murder on Friday.

item.title: Alberta Next panel recommends ditching RCMP, referendum to quit CPP
item.description: EDMONTON — Alberta Premier Danielle Smith’s hand-picked panel re-examining the province's relationship with Ottawa says it’s time to ditch the RCMP and hold a provincewide referendum on quitting the Canada Pension Plan.

item.title: Man charged with second-degree murder in woman's death in London, Ont.
item.description: LONDON — A London man has been charged with second-degree murder in the death of a 47-year-old woman in the city.

item.title: Man accused in fatal Springwater crash denied bail at special hearing
item.description: The 35-year-old man is accused of causing a deadly high-speed crash that claimed the life of a beloved hospital security guard and injured several others, including his kids

item.title: Judge grants bail to Quebec man as 1994 murder conviction under review
item.description: MONTREAL — A man who has spent 33 years behind bars for four murders was granted bail Friday after concerns were raised earlier this year about the fairness of his initial trial.

item.title: Passenger, 19, killed in single-vehicle crash near London, Ont.
item.description: LONDON — Police in Ontario say a 19-year-old was killed and two others were injured in a single-vehicle crash Friday on Highway 401 near London. The Oxford Ontario Provincial Police say the crash happened just after 6:30 p.m.

item.title: Officer shot in Welland, Ont., released from hospital, shelter in place still active
item.description: A police officer in Welland, Ont., was shot Friday in an exchange of gunfire with a suspect who hours later remained holed up in a building swarmed by police attempting to negotiate his surrender.

item.title: Winter wallop continues across Canada, cancelling classes and stranding trucks
item.description: WINNIPEG — Winter continued its late-December march east across Canada Friday, closing classes and stranding trucks. Schools in many areas of southern Manitoba were closed for the second day in a row due to blowing snow and poor road conditions.
